{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' from string to float, handling commas
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders (only completed orders count toward conversion)
completed_df = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Stratify by customer_segment and compute conversion rates within each segment
stratified_rates = completed_df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].agg(['mean', 'count']).reset_index()

# Display the stratified rates
print(stratified_rates)"}
